pages: Odysseus. That gap is not a leap of faith, it is a leap of death. Hold TAB to spin the arrow wheel.
Hover the rope arrow and release to equip it. Now hold the right mouse button to draw the rope taut.
Aim at a ledge with a little architectural confidence. Release, and the rope bites.
The rope holds; I tied it myself. Press W to climb, S to descend. Do try to come back in one piece.
